notes: *first born* is one lexical rendering of `בְּכוֹר` tokenized in two; the head is taken on *first*, with *born* named as a defensible alternative under rule 8, since neither English token names the thing alone.
`מַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם` writes no *of*: rule 19 does not reach a participle the ASV has rendered as an English verb reaching its own object.
